dogecoin.text: To solve my friends problem, I told him to slowly invest more & more into dogecoin at these low prices to improve his Dollar Cost Average(DCA). But I also told him don’t throw no huge sums of money in there until dogecoin has another huge drop
Along with my friend I also own dogecoin at .20 cents. However I took profits when dogecoin reached its tip & I’m not bothered by seeing dogecoin down.

I told him he already had a chance to take profits cause dogecoin went to .33 cents before it dipped down to .15 cents. He told me he didn’t take profits because he was expecting it to keep going higher.
Somebody told me they had $2000 in dogecoin at .20 cents & now it’s at $600 cause dogecoin went down to .15 cents & now he doesn’t know what to do?
